backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing Callaway golf scoring with event submission/update, chart-based deduction calculation, and leaderboard result processing with net score sorting.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting automatic Callaway recalculation when returning from score entry, linking LeaderboardView and App.tsx with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including routing, state management, Callaway calculation engine, leaderboard display, score entry, and chart persistence with localStorage.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Developer documentation explaining how to update default Callaway charts (18-hole and 9-hole) with grid structure, column adjustments, and placeholder cell handling.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Draft restoration marker documenting the current production state including event setup, score entry, Callaway calculation, leaderboard, admin chart editor, and PDF export.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light/dark mode golf-themed color tokens and CSS custom properties for UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tags and title for the Callaway Golf Scoring Calculator application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application with TanStack Router defining three-step scoring flow (setup, entry, leaderboard), settings/admin routes, and state management for event configuration and golfer data.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying copyright, attribution to Dancing Skeleton LLC, and Caffeine.ai branding with dynamic year and UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component with title display, conditional Start Over button, Settings navigation, and admin access button that appears when admin mode is enabled.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin view component that conditionally renders CallawayChartEditor when admin access is enabled, otherwise displays locked state with settings navigation.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: React component providing a tabbed editor for customizing Callaway scoring charts (9 and 18 holes) with grid-based input, validation for half-hole increments, and save/reset functionality.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form component for configuring tournament details including title, course name, golfer count (1-64), hole count (9/18), and course par with validation.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Card component displaying detailed Callaway scoring breakdown for a single golfer including gross score, deduction, adjustment, net score, and hole-by-hole scores.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Card component that displays the active Callaway scoring chart in a table format showing gross score ranges, worst holes, and adjustments for the tournament.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Utility function that generates a print-optimized HTML document for leaderboard standings and opens the browser print dialog for PDF export.

Exports tournament standings to PDF by opening a new browser window with print-optimized HTML content including event title, course name, player rankings, and scores. Uses browser print dialog to generate the PDF with styled tables and headers.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Table component displaying ranked tournament results with trophy/medal icons for top 3 positions, showing rank, player name, net score, gross score, deduction, and adjustment.
Main leaderboard view that calculates Callaway results from golfer scores, displays standings table and breakdowns, and provides PDF export and score editing functionality.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Renders a list of golfer score entry cards with name input and hole-by-hole score inputs, displaying subtotals for front nine, back nine, and gross total. Validates numeric input and calculates running totals as scores are entered.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data by checking for required name, correct hole count, and valid score values (1-15) for each hole. Returns error messages for validation failures or null if valid.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Displays a settings page with a toggle switch to enable/disable admin access to administrative features like the Callaway chart editor. Uses localStorage-backed state management for the admin access setting.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Automatically recreates the actor when identity changes and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccessEnabled: Custom React hook that provides reactive admin access state by listening to localStorage changes and custom events. Returns boolean indicating whether admin features are enabled.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality using DFINITY's AuthClient. Manages authentication state, identity persistence, and provides status indicators for the login process.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching backend data including the latest event result and the Callaway scoring chart. Both hooks depend on the authenticated actor instance.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS styles with a golf-themed color palette using OKLCH color space for both light (cream/paper) and dark (forest green) modes. Imports Merriweather serif and Inter sans-serif fonts for typography.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Core Callaway handicap calculation logic that computes net scores by deducting worst holes based on gross score ranges from backend or grid charts, with support for fractional holes and course par rules.
Defines Callaway chart data structures (CallawayChartEntry, GridCell, GridChartData) and provides legacy default charts for 18-hole and 9-hole scoring with a chart entry lookup function.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Manages localStorage persistence for Callaway charts including active/edited charts and user-default charts, with migration detection from old shipped defaults and safe load/save/reset operations.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/gridPlaceholde: Utility functions for handling placeholder cells (grossScore=0 and worstHoles=0) in Callaway chart grids, including detection, display formatting, and input parsing.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Manages admin access state in localStorage with functions to check and set admin access enabled status, emitting custom events for reactivity.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: TypeScript type definitions for event setup, golfer data with string-based hole scores for form input, and Callaway result data structures.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions for colors (using OKLCH), typography, animations, and design tokens for a golf scorecard UI.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking architectural state, features, and pending feature requests for adding score editing capabilities and automatic recalculation to the golf scorecard application.
